sentences.en: Be sure to put out the fire before you leave.
sentences.zh: 离开前一定要把火扑灭。

sentences.en: A big crowd gathered at the scene of the fire.
sentences.zh: 大火现场聚集了很多人。

sentences.en: It transpired that fire was caused by a careless smoker.
sentences.zh: 后来查明火灾是由于粗心的烟民引起的。
